body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Digifi(www.digifi.kr) showcased its new watch type mp4 player 'Opera S9' equipped with wireless earphone at the 2009 CES in Las Vegas.

Adopting a 1.5-inch LCD display, the Opera S9 supports various multimedia formats including mp4, mp3, wma, and wav. Coming with a wireless dongle, it is compatible with all kinds of wireless earphones from Digifi. It also offers up to six hours of video playing time and 15 hours of music playing time.
Other features included six preset EQ modes, text reader, photo viewer, scheduler function and more. The Opera S9 will be available in March for Korea market and April for global market.
